summary: Adversaries may clear the command history of a compromised account to conceal actions undertaken during an intrusion. Across Linux, macOS, ESXi servers, and network devices, they can delete command history files like ~/.bash_history and /var/log/shell.log or run commands to clear history data. On Windows hosts, adversaries can execute Clear-History to clear current session history or delete and edit the PSReadLine ConsoleHost_history.txt file to hide PowerShell commands.

summary: Adversaries may attempt to access or create a copy of the Active Directory domain database from active Domain Controllers or backups to steal credentials and obtain information about domain members.
